events.text: 🌿 A man, maybe 60s checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.

🌿 A woman, maybe 20s checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the water run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
